Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency numbers. We exported a preliminary inventory of our existing embedding footprint (attached) so you can see doc counts and current shard distribution. A couple of follow-ups from our side:

- We have ~6.2M rows; ~1.1TB of raw vector storage across two environments (prod / analytics).
- Majority of vectors are 1536-d (OpenAI/third-party).
- We plan to keep analytics replica for offline experiments but need prod cutover window with minimal search downtime.

Can you confirm what your recommended backfill strategy is for a dataset this size and any constraints on hourly ingestion throughput? Also, we'd like to schedule a joint runbook review next Tue (6/24) afternoon.

Sarah Taylor

Subject: Re: Embeddings migration: quick inventory and next steps

Hi Sarah — thanks for the inventory. Quick summary and high-level approach below; I included Marissa and Jonas to own implementation and rerank evaluation respectively.

High-level recommendations (for discussion):

1) Staged backfill with dual-write window
   - Start by backfilling a read-only replica in Redwood-managed vectorstore (staging).
   - Dual-write both the existing vector DB and staging for 48–72 hours to compare latencies/PR curves.

2) Vectorstore choice and tradeoffs
   - For your volume we recommend an SSD-backed ANN (Milvus on k8s) or RedisVector for fast p95; Pinecone is acceptable for managed simplicity but has throughput quotas that may require a short burst plan.

3) Backfill throughput & tooling
   - We can sustain ~150k vectors/hour per backfill worker with our standard batch pipeline; we typically run 4 workers during initial backfills and scale to 8 if needed.

4) Rerank & smoke validation
   - Jonas will prepare a 200-query smoke set (seed queries + edge cases) to validate rerank quality and regression thresholds.

Next steps: please confirm a 2-hour window on Tue 6/24 13:00–15:00 PT for runbook review; I'll circulate an implementation_timing_v2.xlsx with milestones.

Thanks,
Neha
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Taylor <sarah.taylor@oliveanalytics.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-06-19T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Embeddings migration: inventory -> production migration playbook

Thanks — added some implementation notes and a tentative schedule. Main operational considerations:

- Index topology: prefer single-shard index per namespace for deterministic rerank indexing; for your 6.2M rows we recommend 8 shards (horizontal) to keep per-shard compaction affordable.
- Cold-start precautions: maintain a small stale-index fallback (30-day TTL) to serve traffic while we finish backfills.
- Consistency: we'll snapshot ingestion offsets to S3 every 6 hours; backfill workers will resume from last successful offset on failure.

I've attached a draft timeline (implementation_timing_v2.xlsx). Proposed fast path:
- Week 1 (preflight): sample backfill 500k vectors to staging + rerank smoke run
- Week 2 (production backfill): rolling backfill over 72 hours with dual-write for live traffic
- Week 3 (cutover): switch read routing to Redwood vectorstore after QA signoff

Open question for Sarah: do you have regulatory constraints on data residency for the analytics replica? If so we can pin staging to us-west-2 only.

Attachments: implementation_timing_v2.xlsx

—
Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2025-06-22T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Embeddings migration: rerank smoke scripts and acceptance criteria

Hi all — draft of rerank validation approach below. I'll walk through this in the runbook meeting.

Rerank validation plan (summary):
- Sample set: 200 queries combining production top-queries, long-tail queries, and adversarial/paraphrase variants.
- Metrics: MRR@5, top1 accuracy, and manual label pass rate for a 40-sample blind eval. Regression guardrails: MRR drop <= 2% and top1 drop <= 3% vs current baseline.
- Smoke scripts: deterministic seed (use fixed RNG) + repeatable scoring pipeline. I'll attach the smoke script outline.

Operational acceptance checklist:
[ ] 500k staging backfill completed and verified checksums
[ ] Rerank smoke set passes regression guardrails
[ ] Fallback routing verified (30-minute failover)
[ ] Documentation of per-token cost delta for the new model config

Note: if the staging MRR is slightly higher but tail regressions exist, we will A/B run 10% traffic for 48 hours before full cutover.

Attachments: rerank-smoke-scripts.md

—
Jonas Weber
Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
